tone.role: the one quiet surface per screen; fields; chips

tone-2.role: hover and pressed state of the tone

skeleton.role: loading blocks (#E2DCE6 on the tone, rgba(246,241,248,0.16) on the plate)

line-strong.role: data only (map inner rings, negative bars)

plum.role: the plate, primary button, links, timeline cursor

on-plum.role: titles and buttons on the plate

on-plum-muted.role: labels on the plate only (1.80 on white: never a mark on the page)

rose-on-plum.role: the live dot on the plate, never a word

placeholder.role: placeholders only, always with a label

wine.role: a dot or a mark: hot crowds, map signs, the logo needle, link hover, errors. Never a button fill, never a word, never an arrow

soft.role: error banner fill only (wine on it 7.77)

text.role: legacy name: emphasis now reads aubergine

focus.ring: 2 px, offset 3 px (2 px on fields); light #F6F1F8 on the plate
focus.inlineLinks: box-shadow 0 0 0 2px var(--focus-halo), 0 0 0 4px var(--focus): a halo of the surface, then the ring, so it never touches the next word

status.rule: weather and status are information, not alarms: they fold into muted; only an error speaks wine

map.style: RadarMap.tsx paints the MapLibre style from land, cold and hot

arc.use: the 20 and 16 px arcs; from 32 px up the arc is full ink

glow.rule: the afterglow, one flat tint: the needle at 12 % over the ground, rose at 18 % over plum; never a fade

sans.use: every sentence, the clock and distances (tabular figures)

body.measure: 32em (about 70 characters; ch is the width of 0, 0.665 em in Instrument Sans, so 66ch set about 97)

typography.floor: nothing under 13 px; 13 px for metadata only

shape.roundOnly: map venues, the radio, the live dot
shape.lines: none: no rails, hairlines, rules, underlines or outlines; the only strokes are data marks, the checkbox ring and the focus ring

select.chevron: 12 x 8 aubergine SVG, 18 px from the right

score.form: the figure, then the Swing: a quarter arc with a floor and a needle that opens from flat (0) to upright (100); arc --mark-arc #806B84 (4.82 on white; #B5A6B8 on the plate, 6.37), plum needle, wine on the chosen moment

empty.mark: a 28 px quarter arc in --mark-arc #806B84 (4.82 on white, 4.38 on tone)

skeleton.motion: opacity 1 to 0.7, 1.6 s, none under reduced motion

logo.name: Swing
logo.colours: walls and arc aubergine #3B1C42 (the 20 and 16 px arcs #806B84), needle wine #84204D, afterglow one flat tint #F0E4EA; reversed on the plate (--mark-ink-reverse #F6F1F8, --mark-needle-reverse #E6A4C2, afterglow #5A3459, --mark-arc-reverse #B5A6B8)
logo.personality: live: the needle swings open once on the home hero (900 ms), still under reduced motion; a wine dot after the word while a crowd is live
logo.sizes: header Wordmark 44 (phone 34) in a 76 px bar (64 on phones); home hero Wordmark 128 (phone 64) with motion; share card white
logo.component: src/components/Logo.tsx (sizes and lockups owned by the logo session)
